title: MODS_Sepsis_1  (GEX)
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from peripheral blood drawn < 48 h after MODS onset using SepMate, washed, ACK-lysed, and cryopreserved (90% FBS / 10% DMSO). Thawed cells were stained (LIVE/DEAD Blue + CD45), filtered, and live singlet CD45⁺ events were sorted on a Cytek Aurora CS. The suspension was adjusted to 1000 cells/µL, washed twice, and loaded directly onto the 10x Chromium controller.

GEMs were generated with 10x Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5′ v2 (Gene Expression + TCR) reagents; on-chip lysis and RT (53 °C 45 min) produced barcoded cDNA. cDNA was amplified, split for gene-expression and TCR V(D)J library prep with the corresponding 10x kits, SPRI-purified, QC-checked (TapeStation), pooled, and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000 S2 flow cell.
data_processing: Reads were aligned to GRCh38 reference using CellRanger pipeline from 10x genomics
Downstream processing of scrna was performed using Seurat
TCR data was analysed using scRepertoire
